request: At the notes POST handler, assess two declared relations between an authenticated caller and an existing document. Both callers hold global add_note, view_document and change_document permissions and can view the document. Use each scenario's object relation to determine whether Note.objects.create is reached.

accepted-policy.text: Creating a note requires the stated global permissions and object-level change_document authorization; a view grant alone is insufficient, while document ownership or an object change grant can satisfy the object control.
accepted-policy.reason: The public task author supplies this accepted policy.

caller.role: Authenticated caller described separately by the two exact scenario premises.

target.type: Protected target fixed in each scenario premise.

view-only.operation: create a note on the document

change-granted.operation: create a note on the document

analysisContract.publicInstruction: Assess both declared scenarios at handler entry using the supplied fixed source and accepted task policy. Treat premises as task assumptions, trace identity/object/control/effect with exact supplied-source citations, and separate policy expectation from observed authorization. Do not execute target code or infer deployment facts.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the caller has the stated global permissions and object view grant, but is not the document owner and has no object change_document grant.

requiredResponseDetails: Trace the decisive source-visible control and protected effect, and compare with the accepted policy.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the caller has the stated global permissions and object view and change_document grants, but is not the document owner.

requiredResponseDetails: Trace the decisive source-visible control and protected effect, and compare with the accepted policy.
